body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance (caching, event-driven, zero idle cost); (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps** so mods touching those APIs "just work", as if one big map.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. **See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface**; basement is routing-only.
- Basement default is solid rock; **with Biomes! Caverns loaded it generates as a living cavern (2026-07-21)**.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat between levels (user directive, run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type; native walls keep vanilla edge lips; fogged deep interior = vanilla fog. USER-VERIFIED run #17. **Better Mountains variant mode (2026-07-22) is the sanctioned exception: when BM swaps a rock to Graphic_Random, the cap fill mirrors BM's own lip-less painterly look.**
- **THE OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip (KindLedge)** — meadows start 1 cell back exactly like ledges (run #43 regression, fixed).
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: gates are `level == 1`; with additional map levels they MUST become "topmost level of the column". Comments at both sites.
- **Pod transit handoff is LATE**: `HandoffTicksToImpact = 22`.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (2026-07-22, user direction, run #50)**: after three mockup rounds and one in-game run, ALL painted depth/height treatments are out — camera parallax, south depth shift, descending skirt faces, descending wall-facade sliver, ascending rim facades, contact shadows, bright lips. What the user actually wanted was a real camera tilt / isometric look (parked in the separate Isometric View prototype mod; NOT this mod's business). The below view stays PLUMB (exact screen<->below mapping — keep this), lightly dimmed (belowDim 0.06), with thin uniform edge hairlines and the wall-top reveal. Do NOT reintroduce painted depth cues without explicit user direction. Save point tags: `pre-height-language`, `pre-compat-tranche`, `pre-cue-removal`.
- **ARCHITECTURE DECISION (2026-07-22)**: single-map "mesa model" rejected (amputates under-mountain interiors, mineable-peak reveal, sky building over open ground). Stacked maps stay; the see-below view renders the REAL lower map live.

## Below-view rendering — current state (post cue-removal)
- Transform: pure altitude drop (BelowOffset -2.5). ScreenToBelowPos = identity passthrough (kept as the single inversion point). ApplyDrawShift = y only.
- Mask: air-cells-only, fog-opaque, belowDim 0.06 default (scribe key belowDimHeight).
- Skirt: ONE thin dark hairline (SkirtLedgeWidth 0.08, vertex-colored mat) in the air cell against every adjacent slab edge; cap borders excluded. Gated by drawSlabEdge.
- Wall-top reveal (drawWallReveal + wallRevealWidth) unchanged — the one surviving rim dressing.
- SectionLayer_ABWallFacade: retired shell (Visible false, body preserved as Regenerate_Retired for clip-machinery reference). SectionLayer_ABRimFacade: DELETED (existed for ~half a day; see git history).
- Below things: printed per air cell; multi-cell things anchor on the FIRST occupied cell under open air (MO formations fix); per-thing shrink 0.85 EXCEPT linked graphics AND rock/ores by def (`mineable || isNaturalRock`) — BM swaps rocks to non-linked Graphic_Random, and def-based exclusion keeps surface mountains full-size and flush from above (run-50 fix; lore saved under compat).

## COMPAT TRANCHE (2026-07-22) — BUILT; biome inherit + BM sky-side verified in run #50 (peak self-test passed 6/6), below-view BM fix awaiting next run
1. **Sky biome inheritance** (`skyBiomeInherit`, default ON): GenStep_ABSkyTerrain swaps the pocket map's deep-scribed PrimaryBiome from AB_OpenSky to the surface biome at creation (cavern mechanism). Regrowth, wild plants, trees, weather follow. Creation-time only; AB_OpenSky def stays (legacy + toggle-off).
2. **Medieval Overhaul rock formations**: below-print anchor = first air-covered occupied cell (generic multi-cell fix). MO formations are mineable => never reveal/facade candidates (QualifiesAsSupport excludes mineable).
3. **Better Mountains variant mode** (cap layer): non-linked rock graphic -> one deterministic variant sprite per mass cell (StableCellIndex hash, centered, graphic's own drawSize, overlapping like BM's native walls), no link masks / corner fillers; unknown graphic classes get flat MatSingle fill. Material caches (atlas + variants) validated against the LIVE graphic reference (BM re-applies on ITS settings changes). BM first-run config auto-selects Tanyfilina packs, so isolated test sessions exercise variant mode out of the box.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (runs #1-#15) — all USER-VERIFIED
Cross-level combat, ritual attendance, wild-animal wandering, universal targeting hub, sky-view mountain rendering. Pod transit + AA interception USER-VERIFIED run #39.

## 2026-07-21 FEATURE TRANCHE (runs #40-#47)
### 1. Destination-aware stair routing (Movement/StairRouter.cs) — BUILT, self-test in place
Whole-trip scoring (pawn->stairs + climb-as-cells + exit->dest) with pawn-less PassDoors dest-side filter, never bricks. Wired: work/needs/joy/rest/food migration, medical + prisoner transport, haul verdict cache, fetch giver, right-click orders, attack chase, ritual gather, caravan gather. API dest overloads. Dev: `AB: stair-routing self-test`.
### 2. Biomes! Caverns basements — WORKING runs #41-#47
GenStep_ABCavernCarve (order 210): connected worm network + chambers; deep-scribed PrimaryBiome swap; weighted random (Fungal 50/Crystal 35/Earthen 15 — **Earthen is 55C**) or fixed. Biome-authentic floors, rock pillars, BC scatterers, initial flora/fauna. KNOWN-BENIGN: "Scatterer ... could not find cell" ~1x/gen. Dev: `AB: cavern-basement self-test`.
### 3. Naturalistic mountain peaks — verified through run #47 + run #50 (self-test 6/6 on inherited biome)
ONE meadow field (Perlin 0.024, cutoff 0.60); lip ring locked; hidden valleys. Plateau: arable slider, surface-biome flora, outcrop mounts. Fade skirt: vertex-alpha strips 0.8 c, near alpha 150. Dev: `AB: peak-plateau self-test`.
### 4. Camera level lock (QoL): `AB_CameraLevelLock` (default End); suppresses automatic switches; `cameraLockKeybind` setting.
### Fixes landed: run-40 wildPlants dictionary form; run-41 sky auto-roof guard NRE.

### Settings
naturalPeaks + peakSoilFraction + peakVegetation; skyBiomeInherit; cavernBasements + cavernBiome + cavernOpenness (BC-gated); cameraLockKeybind; belowDim (0.06), drawSlabEdge (hairlines), drawWallReveal + wallRevealWidth, belowThingScale. Scroll view.

### Roadmap
Ongoing: vanilla-API parity audit. Deferred: cell-targeted ability casts, beam turrets, scribed turret orders, multi-select formations, cross-level prisoner/animal ritual participation, T9 soak, T5 publishing. Watch: stalagmite density polish, cavern steady-state fauna respawn.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub / animal-wander / ritual-attendance / mech-overseer / bond+home / pod-transit / stair-routing / cavern-basement / peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell (T:); toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select pawns/items in place; bidirectional right-click orders + Reverse Commands; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH water riser, VEF generic duct, Rimefeller chem riser, VCHE chemfuel riser. Biomes! Caverns cavern basements (soft, defName-only). Better Mountains variant-mode rock rendering sky-side + full-size below rocks (soft, graphic-type + def detection). Medieval Overhaul rock formations in below view. Anti-air interception (verified #39). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of explicit scope.

## Status
2026-07-22: Depth cues fully retired (run-50 user verdict); below view is plumb + hairlines + reveal. BM below-view rock fix (no shrink on rock by def) built. Next run verifies: BM rocks full-size/flush from the sky view, MO formation visibility at mountain edges, hairline edges. Then older outstanding items (mech overseer diagnosis, bond/home checks, VCHE companion run), soak, publishing prep.
